div.head: Wl art 7
div.ab: Hoc quoque praecipio et volo, ut omnes habeant et teneant legem Eadwardi regis in terris et in omnibus rebus, adauctis iis quae constitui ad utilitatem populi Anglorum.

I likewise enjoin and desire that all men shall keep and observe the law of King Edward relating to the tenure of estates and all [other] matters, with the additions which I have decreed for the benefit of the English nation.
div.note: Added October 2026 from Robertson pp. 240–241 (text and translation); Liebermann’s text (K–M) not yet added
